meta.name: wan-3-0-prime-reference-to-video
meta.description: Build video clips from reference images, reference videos, and reference audio with Wan-AI Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video on RunComfy. Up to 10 reference images, 5 reference videos and 5 reference audio clips are bound to a prompt that names them as "Image 1", "Video 1", "Audio 1", giving character, product and scene consistency across a 2-30 second shot at 480p, 720p or 1080p with a synchronized audio track. Documents the full input schema, the counted-second pricing model (reference videos are billed as duration, images and audio are not), and when to route to Wan 3.0 Prime text-to-video / image-to-video, Wan 2.7 or Seedance 2.0 Pro instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-3.0-prime/reference-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan 3 prime reference to video", "wan 3.0 prime", "wan3 prime", "reference to video", "ref2v", "keep the same character across shots", "video from reference images", or any explicit ask to generate video from references with this model.

copy.tagline: 把参考图、参考视频和参考音频合成一段带同步音轨的短片,保持人物与场景一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用现成素材生成人物或产品前后一致的短视频
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want short videos where characters or products stay consistent across shots

howto.what: 它通过本机 RunComfy CLI 调用 Wan 3.0 Prime 参考生视频:提示词配合最多 10 张参考图、5 段参考视频、5 段参考音频,产出 2–30 秒、480p/720p/1080p 的视频并下载到指定目录。
howto.when: 当你明确提到 wan 3.0 prime、ref2v、reference to video 等词,或要求用参考图和参考视频保持角色一致地生成视频时,由它接管。

say.text: 用 Image 1 生成 8 秒的 9:16 视频,让她在雨中走过霓虹街头
按 Video 1 的运镜做 8 秒视频,人物用 Image 1
say.note: 一次绑定图、视频等参考

say.text: 先出 480p 的 3 秒草稿看效果,再决定要不要上 1080p

howto.what_en: It runs Wan 3.0 Prime reference-to-video via the local RunComfy CLI: your prompt plus up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips named Image 1 / Video 1 / Audio 1 produce a 2–30s clip at 480p–1080p, downloaded to your folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say wan 3.0 prime, ref2v or reference to video, or ask to keep a character or product consistent across a shot using references. Prompt-only calls are rejected.

say_en.text: Make an 8s 9:16 clip from Image 1: she walks through neon-lit rain.
say_en.note: Runs at default 720p with audio on.

say_en.text: Image 1's person wears Image 2's jacket, matching Video 1's camera move.
say_en.note: Binds three references in one call.

say_en.text: Draft it at 480p for 3 seconds first, then decide on a 1080p render.
say_en.note: Cheaper draft before the final pass.
